role: Public Caduceus history of recent Harmonia runs

ok.description: True when the history read succeeds, including when no runs are recorded.

runs.description: Up to ten newest Harmonia run deeds, one per run ID; empty when no runs are recorded or the history read fails.

run_id.description: Run identity from the deed's routine field.

profile.description: Profile name recorded for the run, or null when unavailable.

finished_at.description: Harmonia finish timestamp, falling back to the deed timestamp; null if neither is a string.

outcome.description: ok for ok or success; failed for failed, failure or refused; null for an unrecognized or absent outcome.

duration_ms.description: Run duration in milliseconds, or null when unavailable.

module_count.description: Recorded module count, or null when unavailable.

updated_count.description: Recorded count of updated modules, or null when unavailable.

failures.description: Recorded module failures; empty when none are available.

level.description: The body's Hyalos log level, or null if the level lookup fails.

firstMissingSignal.description: caduceus-update-history-log-unreadable when the history read fails; omitted when it succeeds.

read.description: An unreadable history still uses this schema with ok false and an empty runs array. Gate and worker errors use caduceus.api.error.v1 instead.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
